responsibilities: ERP account and financial records
MYOB
PPO reads verified account, transaction and status observations. Account creation, credit settings, invoices, payments and corrections follow authorised MYOB processes.
ERP authority confirmed by user; exact fields and roles unverified.
Catalogue, prices and inventory
MYOB candidate master
PPO may retain a dated observation and estimate snapshot. Price basis, supplier costs, stock availability and change rights require explicit agreement.
D-005 / D-006 / D-017; field-family confirmation needed.
Relationships and horticultural context
PPO candidate enrichment
Qualification, Activities, site operators, facilities, growing areas and technical context enrich shared records; a site is not automatically an ERP account location.
D-011; existing logical records plus proposed growing-area extension.
Service orders, appointments and time
Operational authority unresolved
Option A: MYOB owns these records and PPO extends them. Option B: PPO owns operations and hands approved consequences to MYOB. Compare installed capability before selecting one.
D-007; PPO ownership is the current simulation model only.
Projects and engineering
Split by purpose
PPO coordinates approved scope, schedules and technical releases. MYOB supplies authoritative accounting outcomes; native CAD tools retain authoring.
Confirm project/task mapping and financial definitions.
Business documents
SharePoint intended authority
PPO retains authorised links and exact issue manifests. This handbook contains synthetic examples and references only.
D-012; configured document access remains unverified.

relationships: Organisation ↔ ERP customer accounts
One organisation may map to more than one company-specific account. Each verified account mapping has effective dates.
Never join on display name or a customer code alone.
MYOB-001
Organisation ↔ Site parties
A site can have different owner, operator and billing party over time. Preserve prior service and billing context.
An operator change does not rewrite issued packs or invoices.
MYOB-014
Site → Facility → Growing area
PPO site/facility context provides the work location; an area extension needs an adopted receiving schema.
Do not flatten greenhouse bays, nursery benches or irrigation zones into MYOB account locations without evidence.
MYOB-018
Product ↔ Installed equipment
One catalogue item may identify many installed assets. Serial, model, site and history help identify an asset.
A serial is not assumed globally unique. A warranty date is not proof of coverage.
MYOB-031
Project → Tasks → Financial lines
Operational work packages and MYOB project/task dimensions may differ. Keep explicit crosswalks and original line references.
A forecast milestone is not a posted actual, invoice or recognised revenue.
MYOB-040
Reviewed evidence → Handoff → ERP document lines
One approved source can split across targets; several sources can combine only with explicit quantity allocations.
Reconcile at the documented line grain. A browser retry must not add a second charge.
MYOB-051
api: Deployment identity
Instance HTTPS origin; installed product/build; environment; tenant, legal company and branch scope.
Record aliases and secure configuration references here; exact operational values stay in the authorised configuration store.
Endpoint contract
Exact endpoint name/version; top-level entities; detail and linked entities; allowed actions and custom fields.
Obtain the installed contract/schema and record its hash, export time and scope. Do not copy a Default version from an example.
Authentication
Supported OAuth flow or other approved installed-version mechanism; connected application; redirects; scopes; token lifetime, renewal and revocation.
Administrator/partner confirms support. Select least-privilege server-side credentials; never put tokens or secrets into this HTML.
Permissions and entitlement
API entitlement, integration-user access, company/branch/row restrictions and concurrency/session limits.
Prove a permitted read and denied out-of-scope access in the approved test environment. A connection success alone is insufficient.
Reads and change capture
Projection, paging/order, filtering, modification timestamps, deletion/inactivation, late updates and source cutoffs.
Use contract-supported mechanisms. Prove completeness; do not assume a webhook or universal delta token exists.
Future commands
Exact entity/action, preconditions, required fields, hold/release behaviour, line keys, correlation support and duplicate detection.
Each command needs a separate approved contract and test proof. Generic create/update support does not establish financial posting authority.
Limits and recovery
Timeouts, payload limits, throttling, permitted concurrency, retry signals, error body redaction and support escalation.
Measure against the actual licence and environment. No invented requests-per-minute or retry count becomes production policy.
sync: Initial read
Freeze extraction scope and source cutoff; load reference data before dependent records; account for every page and rejected row.
Stage observations before promotion. Save count, source timestamps, contract revision and run identity.
Incremental read
Choose supported polling/change capture after discovery; retain a checkpoint with a tie-breaker and overlap where required.
Deduplicate by qualified key. Advance the checkpoint only after complete successful processing. Reconcile periodic full scope.
Freshness and failure
Show last successful source observation, age and completeness; select frequency from business need and API capacity.
A failed or partial run preserves the last-good observation. Unknown does not display as zero or current.
Inactivation and deletion
Distinguish inactive, cancelled, deleted, inaccessible and omitted-by-filter records.
Do not infer deletion from a missing page or lost permission. Preserve references used by issued documents and historical handoffs.
Conflict and mapping change
One authorised writer per field family; compare expected source/mapping revision before any handoff.
Route conflicts to an owner. Do not use last-write-wins for ERP financial data. Revalidate changed account/company mappings.
Proposed outbound work
Commit the PPO approved intent and durable receipt/outbox together; preserve payload and correlation identity.
Recheck permission, exact approval and source revisions at processing. This handbook does not enable outbound work.
Unknown result
A timeout after a command may mean the ERP processed it. Stop equivalent retries and locate the actual target.
Found once: bind and reconcile. Proven absent: permit a controlled retry. Uncertain or duplicate: keep an owned exception.
Reconciliation and corrections
Compare like company, currency, tax basis, UOM and line grain; retain reversals and linked successor evidence.
Application rollback does not reverse ERP effects. Finance performs and evidences any required correction in MYOB.

workflows.title: Equipment and parts sale
workflows.example: A fictional grower orders replacement irrigation valves.
steps: Sales confirms customer, site and requirement.
Estimator records exact item, quantity, UOM and price-source revision.
An authorised commercial process accepts the order; Finance confirms account/terms.
MYOB order, dispatch and invoice outcomes are processed through the agreed authority.
PPO displays verified source references, quantities and statuses.
workflows.exception: Item unavailable or a one-off item is requested: route for authorised item resolution; do not silently create catalogue records.
workflows.completion: Close when fulfilment and financial references are evidenced; partial supply remains visible.

workflows.title: Planned service visit
workflows.example: A fictional dosing unit requires an annual service.
steps: Coordinator checks account mapping, equipment identity, access and readiness.
Approved work order and appointment lead to the exact issued job pack.
Technician captures labour, parts and findings; customer attendance acceptance is separate.
Service reviews exact evidence; Finance dispositions all allocated quantities.
Processor records actual MYOB results and reconciles each approved source line.
workflows.exception: Lost command response: keep OutcomeUnknown, locate the actual target and reconcile before any retry.
workflows.completion: A completed visit can retain follow-up. A reconciled handoff does not close unrelated defects.

workflows.title: Equipment upgrade
workflows.example: A fictional nursery upgrades climate controls in Glasshouse 02.
steps: Agree affected site, facility, installed assets and existing configuration.
Estimate against exact supplier/item/price evidence and approved scope.
Engineering releases the design; purchasing confirms required material.
Installation records changed equipment/configuration and commissioning evidence.
Finance reconciles approved work and material outcomes; retained asset history links predecessor and successor.
workflows.exception: Substitution changes technical scope: review compatibility, estimate and design revision before procurement or installation.
workflows.completion: Close only the agreed upgrade scope with commissioning, document and commercial evidence.

workflows.title: Major greenhouse project
workflows.example: A fictional grower builds two production structures with multiple irrigation zones.
steps: Agree customer/site/structure/area context and exact contract scope.
Map operational work packages to verified ERP project/task dimensions.
Engineering releases staged work; Supply Chain records commitments, promises and receipts.
Project coordination tracks installation, variations and forecasts independently of posted actuals.
Finance reviews progress billing and costs; commissioning and final handover retain exact records.
workflows.exception: Supplier delay or variation: record owned impact and revised forecast; neither creates an accounting budget change automatically.
workflows.completion: Close against accepted scope, outstanding defects, handover and reconciled commercial obligations.

workflows.title: Warranty, return and supplier recovery
workflows.example: A fictional pump fails during a potential warranty period.
steps: Record fault, equipment identity and installed/configuration history.
Service and Finance decide coverage using actual terms and evidence.
Authorised return and replacement follow their own stock and logistics processes.
Customer credit, non-billable work and supplier recovery each receive separate disposition.
Link original sale, failed asset, return receipt, replacement and verified credit/recovery outcomes.
workflows.exception: Supplier rejects recovery: keep the owned commercial exposure open; do not reverse customer acceptance or hide the cost.
workflows.completion: Each physical and financial consequence has its own evidenced outcome and remaining-work owner.

steps.instruction: Walk representative records with users; distinguish required, optional, unused and unknown fields.
steps.evidence: Usage inventory with record context; no production values copied into this public pack.

procedures.completion: An owned discovery backlog with specific missing evidence.

procedures.title: Verify field and relationship mappings
procedures.precondition: Approved read access to representative records; no configuration change.

steps.title: Record observed labels
steps.instruction: Capture the actual screen ID, tab, label, technical name if available and business use.
steps.evidence: Observed usage with source date and environment.

steps.title: Resolve identity
steps.instruction: Confirm company/entity/header/line keys; inspect duplicate names, multiple account locations and site parties.
steps.evidence: Qualified key and relationship examples.

steps.title: Compare the endpoint contract
steps.instruction: Match screen meaning to the installed schema; inspect defaults, custom fields, linked/detail entities and permitted actions.
steps.evidence: Exact endpoint/version/path and schema hash; unavailable fields recorded.

steps.title: Review the receiving field
steps.instruction: Distinguish existing PPO logical fields from proposed extensions; approve type, null, UOM, status and transformation rules.
steps.evidence: Mapping review referencing its evidence; no inferred schema change.

procedures.completion: A mapping can be Observed in MYOB without being API verified or Approved.

procedures.title: Prepare a read-only test connection
procedures.precondition: Separate non-production access approval, supported-version documentation and least-privilege role.

steps.title: Confirm the environment
steps.instruction: Match installed version, test tenant/company and permitted branch scope against approved evidence.
steps.evidence: Environment identity recorded; production endpoint excluded.

steps.title: Configure supported authentication
steps.instruction: Administrator uses installed-version instructions for the selected mechanism, app/redirects/scopes and credentials.
steps.evidence: Redacted registration and role evidence; secrets stored only server-side.

steps.title: Establish connection metadata
steps.instruction: Use an environment-specific connection alias and approved endpoint/version; record timeout/capacity limits.
steps.evidence: Versioned configuration references without secret values.

steps.title: Prove a bounded read
steps.instruction: Request only an approved sample; verify returned company/key, denied out-of-scope access, token expiry and logout/revocation behaviour as applicable.
steps.evidence: Redacted request/response and permission results. No write action used.

procedures.completion: A working authenticated read with correct identity and access boundaries; full extraction remains unproved.

procedures.title: Run and reconcile an initial read pilot
procedures.precondition: PROC-02/03 complete for the selected fields and dataset.

steps.title: Define a bounded extraction
steps.instruction: Choose a company, record family, filter, cutoff, expected count and complete paging strategy.
steps.evidence: Versioned extraction plan and baseline comparison.

steps.title: Stage the records
steps.instruction: Load reference data first; validate required keys, values, relationships, UOM and status; retain rejected rows separately.
steps.evidence: Run identity, page/count evidence and rejection reasons.

steps.title: Reconcile scope
steps.instruction: Compare source records and totals on identical definitions; investigate missing pages, duplicate keys and company mismatches.
steps.evidence: Record-level reconciliation; counts alone are insufficient.

steps.title: Promote the observation
steps.instruction: Only complete, accepted observations become current; show source-as-at and observed-at. Test a failed follow-up run.
steps.evidence: Last-good data survives failure; no empty/zero replacement.

procedures.completion: Verified reads for this exact scope; no general production integration claim.

procedures.title: Process a reviewed manual Finance handoff
procedures.precondition: Operational use requires approved authority and mappings; today rehearse with synthetic data only.

steps.title: Review exact evidence
steps.instruction: Confirm account/company, report revisions, allocated quantities and Billable/NonBillable dispositions.
steps.evidence: Approved source snapshot; unresolved coverage stays held.

steps.title: Claim before processing
steps.instruction: Use the existing handoff workflow; record the accountable processor and AwaitingERP state.
steps.evidence: One processing claim and correlation identity.

steps.title: Record the source result
steps.instruction: Use the authorised MYOB process when operationally approved; record actual company/document/line keys, quantities, status and evidence.
steps.evidence: Processed, proven NotProcessed or OutcomeUnknown; never a guessed reference.

steps.title: Reconcile and close
steps.instruction: Compare source allocations to ERP lines on the same basis; evidence any authorised no-posting outcome.
steps.evidence: Reconciled only when line evidence and reviewed differences are complete.

procedures.completion: Originals remain immutable; corrections use linked successors and evidenced ERP actions.

procedures.title: Recover an unknown command outcome
procedures.precondition: A command may have reached the ERP; preserve its original payload, identity and timestamps.

steps.title: Stop equivalent retries
steps.instruction: Hold the original operation and show OutcomeUnknown with an accountable owner.
steps.evidence: No duplicate enqueue, replacement key or blind resubmit.

steps.title: Locate actual effects
steps.instruction: Search the permitted ERP scope using documented correlation and business keys, then inspect header and line evidence.
steps.evidence: Found once, proven absent, duplicates found or still uncertain.

steps.title: Choose the evidenced path
steps.instruction: Found once: bind target and reconcile. Proven absent: release a controlled retry. Duplicate/uncertain: escalate and retain the hold.
steps.evidence: Decision with source evidence, actor and time.

steps.title: Retain correction history
steps.instruction: Any financial reversal/correction is performed under Finance authority; keep links to original operation and target.
steps.evidence: One explained financial outcome; no deletion of history.

procedures.completion: A software redeploy or rollback does not undo an external transaction.

procedures.title: Investigate a sync failure or conflict
procedures.precondition: Last-good observation and failed run metadata are available.

steps.title: Classify the failure
steps.instruction: Separate auth/permission, throttling, transient transport, validation, schema change and conflicting edits.
steps.evidence: Redacted diagnostics and affected scope.

steps.title: Protect current context
steps.instruction: Preserve last-good data; mark age/completeness/failure; prevent unsupported downstream decisions.
steps.evidence: No false current status or automatic zero balance.

steps.title: Correct at the authorised source
steps.instruction: Resolve credentials, mappings or data with the assigned owner. Do not bypass role restrictions or overwrite ERP fields from PPO.
steps.evidence: Reviewed correction and expected-version context.

steps.title: Replay and reconcile
steps.instruction: Resume from the last committed checkpoint only after safe retry conditions; revalidate counts, keys and relevant financial basis.
steps.evidence: No missing, duplicated or cross-company observations.

procedures.completion: Close the incident with scope, recovery evidence and follow-up owner.

procedures.title: Prepare an upgrade or credential rotation
procedures.precondition: Planned change scope and approved test environment.

steps.title: Capture the current contract
steps.instruction: Record app configuration references, endpoint/schema hash, customisations and test baseline.
steps.evidence: Known recoverable configuration; secrets excluded from the handbook.

steps.title: Compare and rehearse
steps.instruction: Diff entity/field/action/status/default changes; test permission, token renewal/revocation and representative workflows.
steps.evidence: Changed mappings identified and previously approved mappings flagged for review.

steps.title: Approve release readiness
steps.instruction: Review affected fields and acceptance results with process owners; confirm support, cutover, in-flight operations and rollback plan.
steps.evidence: Explicit release decision; checklist ticks alone are not approval.

steps.title: Observe after change
steps.instruction: Reconcile first reads/results, watch errors and freshness, and resolve any in-flight unknown effects.
steps.evidence: Dated verification and revision history; original evidence retained.

procedures.completion: Revalidate the exact changed scope before operational reliance.

tests.title: Correct company
tests.scenario: Two synthetic companies share a customer code.
tests.expected: Each resolves only through its connection/company/entity context.

tests.title: Permission boundary
tests.scenario: A test role requests another company, restricted Finance detail or a disallowed action.
tests.expected: Denied without record leakage or side effects.

tests.title: Missing required field
tests.scenario: Customer key or required currency/UOM is absent.
tests.expected: Reject or hold with an owned reason; never substitute a guessed value.

tests.title: Optional and unknown values
tests.scenario: An optional field is missing and a quantity is genuinely zero.
tests.expected: Show unknown separately from known zero; preserve null meaning.

tests.title: Custom field and schema change
tests.scenario: An expected custom field disappears or changes type.
tests.expected: Affected mapping stops passing verification and retains last-good evidence.

tests.title: Identity and relationship ambiguity
tests.scenario: Duplicate names or multiple candidate ERP locations match a site.
tests.expected: No automatic merge; explicit reviewed crosswalk and effective history.

tests.title: Hierarchy and moves
tests.scenario: A facility points to a different site or an asset moves.
tests.expected: Reject invalid hierarchy; reviewed move preserves prior service context.

tests.title: Complete pagination
tests.scenario: The second of two declared source pages fails.
tests.expected: Run remains incomplete; no verified total or advanced checkpoint.

tests.title: Incremental boundaries
tests.scenario: Two updates share a timestamp; one arrives late.
tests.expected: Supported checkpoint/order strategy captures both without omission or duplication.

tests.title: Inactivation and lost access
tests.scenario: A source record becomes inactive, then permission hides another record.
tests.expected: Distinguish statuses; neither erases historical links nor infers deletion from absence.

tests.title: Units and quantities
tests.scenario: Synthetic pack of 10 EA is compared to 2 packs; no conversion exists for another item.
tests.expected: 20 EA only under the explicit conversion; unknown conversion is held.

tests.title: Money and tax basis
tests.scenario: AUD excluding-tax value is compared to NZD or including-tax value.
tests.expected: Not comparable until an approved conversion/tax definition exists.

tests.title: Known account fixture
tests.scenario: Synthetic invoice 1,100; applied payment 400; applied credit 100; source remaining 600.
tests.expected: Show original 1,100 and remaining 600 separately.

tests.title: Unapplied receipt
tests.scenario: Add a synthetic unapplied receipt of 200 to the previous fixture.
tests.expected: Invoice remaining stays 600; unapplied cash is shown separately.

tests.title: Reversal lineage
tests.scenario: Reverse the synthetic 400 payment; source remaining is 1,000.
tests.expected: Show 1,000 with reversal lineage and current source-as-at.

tests.title: Allocation integrity
tests.scenario: 90 MIN approved; 60 Billable and 30 NonBillable. Repeat or concurrently allocate.
tests.expected: All 90 remain dispositioned once; no duplicate charge or silent reallocation.

tests.title: Unknown command result
tests.scenario: Simulator records a target, then loses the response.
tests.expected: OutcomeUnknown; lookup binds the same target; exactly one simulated effect.

tests.title: Partial external processing
tests.scenario: Header exists but a required line/action outcome cannot be confirmed.
tests.expected: Keep reconciliation/unknown exception; do not mark the whole handoff complete.

tests.title: Stale source or approval
tests.scenario: Account mapping or report revision changes before processing.
tests.expected: Original approval is not silently reused; return for review or reconcile possible effects.

tests.title: Expiry and throttling
tests.scenario: Credential expires or source rejects excess requests.
tests.expected: Classified failure; safe bounded read retry or reauthentication; no blind command retry.

tests.title: Last-good observation
tests.scenario: A successful read is followed by a failed refresh.
tests.expected: Retain prior values with visible source time and failure; no zero replacement.

tests.title: Upgrade and recovery
tests.scenario: Change endpoint schema/configuration in the approved test environment.
tests.expected: Contract diff, focused retest and restored checkpoint preserve in-flight history.

tests.title: Document and response revision
tests.scenario: A report changes after a customer response.
tests.expected: Successor revision has no inherited acknowledgement; original evidence remains accessible.

tests.title: Warranty consequences
tests.scenario: Technical warranty claim is accepted but supplier recovery is denied.
tests.expected: Physical return, customer treatment and supplier recovery have separate outcomes and owners.
